title: Yoga intersubjectif
text: inter subjective yoga is a really fundamental part of my contribution to the evolution of post-traditional spirituality and on the becoming dimensions of of of my Retreats what I do is is we go from really spending most of the time sitting as sitting very quietly as individuals to coming together in groups and in these groups I I teach people a certain methodology which is ask people not to uh uh uh not to speak about anything personal to dwell on these very big metaphysical and philosophical questions that I'm bringing up and I and I teach people a method of of learn of learning how to listen to each other right because we often we're not very good listeners we're usually very much too invested in what we already think and what we already believe and what happens on on these Retreats is that within really one two or three days uh individuals start to feel a different deeper dimension of their own self begin to come to the front or come to the surface uh and when when the when the separate self or the or the ego or the narcissistic self sense falls into the background what comes into the foreground is what I call the authentic self and the authentic self is the experience of unselfconscious liberated spontaneity when you when when you have that experience of unselfconscious liberated spontaneity you find access to a creative potential at the level of thought and the level of intuition and and the level of Engagement that is utterly and remarkably transformative and then you realize oh this is what it's like to be a liberated human being this is what it could be like to be a liberated human being and not and even better than that when others in within the same context are having the same experience of liberated uh of liberated awareness this freedom from self-consciousness and the uh experience of of Awakened inspiration that's free that's free from Fear you you find yourself engaging with other people from a completely different part of yourself that you may have never known before and so so and when people have that kind of experience they really know what's possible for human beings in between human beings and um and of course one of the the one of as I said earlier on you know the big question for me in for this well over a quarter Century that I've been teaching is is I wanted to bring the experience of enlightened awareness into into the realm of of action and Inter subjective between individuals inter subjective engagement or this inter subjective yoga because most of the time the experience of enlightened awareness happens within the context of the unique individual sitting quietly by the by themselves or going for a walk in nature or having some kind of experience that exists within the realm of their own subjective experience but what I've done is is is is come up with this this in subjective yoga that gives people an experience of of a of having this kind of exper of of of Awakening in such a way where you're now able to engage with others within this experience of of of um being free from doubt being free from self-consciousness being free from self-c concern and experience this this awakened liberated inspiration and when you share that with other people and they share that with you and you and you're in a back and forth and you realize well this is a completely different kind of Human Experience
